text: There is no evidence that private fund adviser regulation in Title IV of the Dodd-Frank Act increases returns to scale, which counters the most damning putative concern raised about regulatory compliance costs.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Impact of Dodd-Frank Act Compliance Cost on the Hedge Fund Industry (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389423
